title: India’s EV expansion kick-off June 15 with 16 rollouts vs 7 ICE models
description: India’s passenger vehicle market is set for its busiest product cycle in years, with automakers preparing 23 launches over the next nine months — including 16 electric vehicles (EVs) and seven internal combustion engine (ICE) models. Major players such as Mercedes-Benz and Tata Motors plan to roll out new electric and hybrid offerings, driven by rising fuel costs and shifting consumer preferences.
